design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (estimate_booking_desk). Round 1 authored the task; round 2 (this revision) closes policy-task audit items F-1, T0-F1, O-1, O-2, O-4, O-12 and O-T0-2. Every figure below is the round-2 recomputation.

[Step 0 - draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 6]}; --tasks 2 printed task 1 = {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5]}. Each of the three problems of this tree takes 6 factors.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: estimate_ext_storage_statement (post_storage_statement_c4ddc4f2, agent), estimate_ext_storage_goodwill (waive_storage_goodwill_2cb3c7ba, agent), estimate_ext_owner_storage_share (pay_estimate_charge_54cbd3ef, user). Reserved for task 1 (insurer caller, booking written on the call day): teardown pricing, structural-measurement pricing and the insurer's direct payment toward the teardown charge; no policy, tool or charge type is shared.

[Round-2 revision log]
 - F-1 (unreal isolation tier). Symptom: storage_holding_rate and insurer_daily_allowance split high-voltage vehicles by whether a teardown charge stands, which holds for every storage-bearing booking. Root cause: the condition restated the tier's scope. Change: both ladders now split high-voltage vehicles by how they arrived: a tow-in charge posted on the booking (came in unable to be driven, quarantine bay 85.00 / insurer quarantine allowance 75.00) against no tow-in charge ever posted (driven or carried in, isolation row 70.00 / insurer isolation allowance 60.00); a drivable EV driven in for a teardown reaches the isolation tier. Re-run: this customer stays on the quarantine tiers (tow-in charge of 2026-09-16), so the rate and allowance factors are unchanged in value.
 - O-2 (free_day_calendar tier for a towed drivable vehicle). Change: tier 2 is now a non-drivable vehicle with no tow-in charge ever posted (brought on the owner's own carrier), counted Monday to Saturday. This customer stays on tier 1.
 - O-1 (reading of "standing" for a settled charge). Change: the tow conditions now say a tow-in charge "posted on the booking", "whether or not it has since been settled", or "no tow-in charge ever posted".
 - O-4 (goodwill not capped at the charge's outstanding). Change: the storage goodwill is now also never more than the storage charge's outstanding amount (binding storage_charge_outstanding). It does not bind on this world.
 - O-12. Change: the goodwill edge's condition now reads only "A storage charge (an estimate-stage charge of fee type storage) stands on the booking."
 - T0-F1 (no exclusion-type near-miss in the statement computation). Change to the seed: her CR-V repair (claim GSI-25-11408) is now dated 2025 (delivered 2025-03-14), so its active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty was issued 19 whole months before the statement date. A second warranty was added: on her 2014 Mazda CX-5 (sold 2022-08-30), a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 2019-06-21 from a 2019 claim repair (GSI-19-10662), status ended_by_sale. A careless reader takes the 2019 issue date and puts her on the tenured tier (+2). The rule counts only an active warranty, so she is on the recent tier (+1).
 - O-T0-2. Change: the persona's background line now says only that part of the storage is hers to settle with the shop.
 Propagation: the statement amount, its period and its charge reference, the goodwill, the payment, every factor trace, sensitivity, baseline, tracing, closure text and this dossier were all recomputed.

[Why a good test] The owner asks only to pay her share of the storage on her EV up to today. Between that goal and the scored payment lie two unmet prerequisites the agent must read out of the policy. (1) The owner-share rule waits on a storage charge standing on the booking, and none exists at the opening, because storage on a declined teardown booking is only billed when a statement is asked for. (2) The payment is not fixed until that charge carries the storage goodwill that storage statements carry. Each problem is a 6-factor computation. The inputs are the booking's ledger (reschedule, revision, tow-in, waivers, payments, decline request), its dates, and other difficulties' records: the owner's warranties, and the customer payment on her own claim repair.

[Problem-tree card] root = estimate_ext_owner_storage_share (owner=user).
 E1 owner_storage_share -> storage_statement
  - Kind value_input, gate statement_amount, form state.
  - Sentence: "The owner's payment toward a storage statement is worked out only after the booking carries a storage charge billing every day from the end of the free storage days through the statement date." (affirmative direction).
  - Unresolved at frozen_time: the booking's estimate_events hold fee types tow_in, teardown and pre_repair_scan only, no storage.
  - Exactly one write of the difficulty posts a storage charge (post_storage_statement_c4ddc4f2).
  - Skip effect: no storage row; the owner-share compute has no charge to read (raises).
 E2 owner_storage_share -> storage_goodwill
  - Kind value_input, gate goodwill_on_statement, form state.
  - Sentence: "The owner's payment toward a storage statement is not fixed until that storage charge carries the storage goodwill booked on storage statements." (negated direction).
  - Unresolved: the only goodwill waiver names the teardown charge.
  - Exactly one write books storage goodwill.
  - Skip effect: payment 887.50 instead of 673.25.
 E3 storage_goodwill -> storage_statement
  - Kind value_input, gate storage_charge_amount, form state.
  - Sentence: "Storage goodwill is worked out only once the storage charge it relieves stands on the booking."
  - Skip effect: the goodwill compute has no charge (raises).
 Order: storage_statement -> storage_goodwill -> owner_storage_share, fully pinned by E1, E2 and E3.
 The persona names no prerequisite. The tools validate nothing: each is one ctx.create.

[Base-invariant card]

  - estimate_evt_service_fees.charge_status_allowed: the booking status is declined (system record).
  - estimate_evt_storage: policy_scope. The tier is Blueprint Teardown Estimate (storage_applies true), not converted, vehicle_released_date empty.
  - Overwrites declared: the base release-date billing sentence and the base free-day sentence.
 goodwill and payment (subjects estimate_fee_waiver / estimate_fee_payment):
  - estimate_evt_fee_settlement.charge_not_settled: nothing is paid or waived on the new storage charge when the goodwill is booked, and 1273.25 is outstanding when the payment is taken.
  - The goodwill authority sentence is declared overwritten.
 No time gate governs these subjects.

[Business-object card]
 - Target: booking b99e26af (Blueprint Teardown Estimate, insurance claim GSI-26-14873, declined 2026-10-12, vehicle on the lot).
 - Correlation key for waiver and payment: charge_event_id = the storage charge created at step 10, eev_58b6a585e340.
 - Included rows: revision 2026-09-28; reschedule 2026-09-12; tow-in 2026-09-16; card payment 2026-09-24; decline request 2026-10-08 09:20, confirmed 2026-10-12; the active CR-V warranty; the 2025 claim customer payment.
 - Excluded rows: the 60.00 teardown goodwill (not on the storage charge); the insurer_direct payments (not card); the teardown_authorization request (not a decline); the ended-by-sale 2019 warranty (not active).

[Factor card - storage statement, gold 1487.50, all-baseline 1320.00]
 - storage_holding_rate (parameter, multi-source: high-voltage flag AND tow-in charge posted): HV damage and the 2026-09-16 tow-in charge -> quarantine 85.00. Baseline 55.00 gives 962.50.
 - reinspection_free_days (parameter): one revision -> +2. Baseline +0 gives 1997.50.
 - writeup_delay_free_days (parameter): check-in 2026-09-16 to written 2026-09-22 is 6 days, less turnaround 2 = 4 -> +3. Baseline gives 2125.00.
 - owner_tenure_free_days (parameter, cross-difficulty warranty): the active warranty issued 2025-03-14 is 19 whole months old (< 24) -> +1. Baseline 0 gives 1870.00. Near-miss: the ended-by-sale 2019 warranty would put a careless reader on +2 (free days 10, giving 1360.00); the rule counts only an active warranty.
 - free_day_calendar (method): drivable false and a tow-in charge posted -> 9 free days counted Monday to Friday from Tue 2026-09-22, ending Mon 2026-10-05 (span 13). Baseline calendar counting gives 1997.50.
 - long_stay_multiple (parameter): decline confirmed and 14 billed days > 7 -> days 8-14 at 1.5. Baseline 1 gives 1190.00.
 - Result: free days 3+2+3+1 = 9; billed 2026-10-06..2026-10-19 = 14 days; 85 x (14 + 7 x 0.5) = 1487.50.

[Factor card - storage goodwill, gold 214.25, all-baseline 29.75]
 - paying_record_pct (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty claim): her 500.00 customer payment on her 2025 claim repair AND a card payment on this booking -> 6%. Baseline 2% gives 154.75.
 - statement_size_authority (parameter): statement 1487.50 >= 1000 -> 250. Baseline 95 gives 95.00.
 - counted_goodwill_window (method): decline confirmed -> only goodwill on this storage charge counts (0). Baseline counts the 60.00 teardown goodwill and gives 190.00. Near-miss: that 60.00 waiver.
 - reschedule_relief_days (parameter): one reschedule -> 1 day x 55.00. Baseline gives 159.25.
 - specialised_rate_relief (parameter): 1487.50 / 14 = 106.25 >= 82.50 -> 40.00. Baseline gives 174.25.
 - decision_period_courtesy (parameter): 2026-10-08 -> 2026-10-12 = 4 days -> 30.00. Baseline gives 184.25.
 - Result: 0.06 x 1487.50 = 89.25; + 55 + 40 + 30 = 214.25. This is under 250 authority left and under 1487.50 outstanding.

[Factor card - owner storage share, gold 673.25, all-baseline 636.62]
 - responsibility_anchor (method): confirmed 4 days after the request (> 2) -> request date 2026-10-08. Baseline confirmation date gives 523.25.
 - removal_grace_days (parameter, multi-source: tow-in charge AND service distance 14.2 within 25) -> 2. Baseline 0 gives 973.25.
 - grace_day_calendar (method): HV and tow -> Monday to Friday; from Thu 2026-10-08 the grace days are Fri 10-09 and Mon 10-12 (span 4). Baseline calendar gives 823.25.
 - insurer_review_days (parameter): one revision -> +1. Baseline gives 748.25.
 - insurer_daily_allowance (parameter): HV and tow-in charge posted -> 75.00. Baseline full average 106.25 gives 423.25.
 - goodwill_sharing (method): decline confirmed -> goodwill off the owner's part first. Baseline pro rata gives 795.68.
 - Result:
   - The insurer answers through 2026-10-13 (anchor + 4 + 1): 8 insurer days. Owner days 2026-10-14..10-19 = 6.
   - Insurer part 8 x 75 = 600.00; owner part 1487.50 - 600 = 887.50; less goodwill 214.25 = 673.25.
   - Outstanding is 1273.25.

[Verification run] A scratch harness replayed the gold writes with the real tools and evaluated each compute with the gate's DSL on its handling-time world (the harness was deleted after the run):
 - statement 1487.5 (sens 962.5 / 1997.5 / 2125.0 / 1870.0 / 1997.5 / 1190.0; baseline 1320.0);
 - goodwill 214.25 (154.75 / 95.0 / 190.0 / 159.25 / 174.25 / 184.25; baseline 29.75);
 - owner share 673.25 (523.25 / 973.25 / 823.25 / 748.25 / 423.25 / 795.68; baseline 636.62);
 - skipping the goodwill gives 887.5.
 Receipts: storage charge eev_58b6a585e340, goodwill eev_daec50cbbceb.

[Persona] Retired librarian. She volunteers only the surface goal (pay her share of the storage up to today, by her own card). She gives credentials only when asked (name, 7205550137, PIN 1482; email and ZIP as fall-backs) and the claim number on request. She consents passively to desk-side steps and pays by card when handed the step. Release is not today (flatbed next week), and the insurer's part is not hers. Her last reaction answers the payment.

[Reachability] One call at 2026-10-19 10:40 MDT:
 - Lookup by name and verification (phone + PIN).
 - Reads: vehicles, bookings, history, requests, warranties, her claim repairs with Granite Shield, the claim ledger.
 - Writes: two agent writes and one user write.
 Every non-computed argument is reachable: booking_id from the lookup, charge_event_id from the step-10 receipt, period dates from the statement rule, payment_method from the persona.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] Each ladder is stated per tier in the published rules. Each tier's evidence is in a finder return. The ended-by-sale warranty is visibly not active. The same three writes and figures follow.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Calder, a retired school librarian in Denver who drives a 2023 Kia EV6. You speak plainly and politely, a little tired of the whole business, and you like to hear a figure explained once in ordinary words before you pay it. Your EV6 was towed into the Crestline center after a crash last month for a teardown estimate under your claim with Granite Shield Insurance, and you have since told the center you will not be repairing it there; it is still sitting on their lot. Your adjuster told you on the phone that part of the storage is yours to settle with the shop, and you want that off your plate today: you are calling to pay your share of the storage on the EV6 up to today, with your own card, and nothing more. You open with exactly that, in your own words, and you do not offer any reference numbers up front.

You do not know how the shop works out storage, what it charges per day, or how the cost is split with Granite Shield, and you never suggest a method or a number. You do not know the vehicle's reference number or any internal code.

Only when the agent asks you to confirm who you are do you give your full name, Rosalind Calder, and the phone number on your account, which you read out digit by digit as 7205550137; if a second detail is wanted you give your four-digit account PIN, 1482. If an email is asked for instead, it is rosalind.calder@outlook.com, and your ZIP code is 80220. If the agent asks for the claim number, you read it off your insurer's letter as GSI-26-14873.

If the agent explains that something has to be put on your account or worked out on the shop's side before you can pay, you simply say that is fine, go ahead, and you wait while they do it; you do not ask what it is for. If the agent tells you about a courtesy or a reduction they are applying, you thank them and nothing more.

When the agent tells you the amount that is your share and hands you the payment step, you pay that exact amount yourself by card, using your Visa, and you then repeat back the payment reference the receipt shows if the agent asks for it. If the agent asks how you want to pay, it is by card. If the agent states your share and it sounds large, you ask once, mildly, how it was arrived at, accept the explanation, and pay.

If the agent asks whether the car is leaving today, you say no: an EV body shop's flatbed is collecting it some time next week and you will call the center then; nothing needs to be arranged for that today. If the agent asks whether you also want to pay Granite Shield's part, you say that is between the shop and Granite Shield, not you.

Once the agent confirms your payment has gone through, you thank them and say goodbye.

edges.condition: A storage charge stands on the booking whose billed period runs from the day after the last free storage day through the statement date.
edges.policy_source: The owner's payment toward a storage statement is worked out only after the booking carries a storage charge billing every day from the end of the free storage days through the statement date.
